stories.title: Trump blames aging equipment for FAA ground stop, asks Congress for upgrade funds
new_facts: A nationwide FAA ground stop occurred and Trump denies responsibility for it.
Trump berated an NBC reporter over White House construction priorities, telling her 'You don't have talent'.
NBC's Yamiche Alcindor asked about D.C. construction versus crumbling aviation; Trump replied 'Losers like you'.
Trump blamed 'very old equipment that had a heart attack'; Duffy expects air travel normal Monday.
Trump was informed within 30 minutes of the Friday afternoon FAA ground stop, per U.S. officials.
Trump was absent from public view for five days before reappearing Monday.
Trump praised Transportation Secretary Duffy over the ground stop; Asia trip includes a meeting with Putin.
Ground stop affected over a million passengers; Trump blamed half-century-old equipment and flew on a Qatar-gifted jet.
Departures were grounded nationwide for more than four hours; delays lingered into Monday.
DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin said no one is expected to be fired over the ground stop.
Trump's multi-day Asia swing includes summits with Putin and Xi and a possible meeting with Kim.
stories.line: A nationwide FAA air traffic ground stop halted flights; Trump blames aging equipment and asks Congress for upgrade funding.
